scripts.build:android:ops: node scripts/detect-lan-ip.js && node scripts/prepare-capacitor-flavor.js ops && npm run build:ops && npx cap sync android && node scripts/configure-android-flavors.js && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleOpsRelease
